threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think you can just hop on the Tube to get anywhere, but then you end up stuck on a bus for an hour due to strikes. Welcome to London!
Caught the 188 late last night, and the driver was blasting classic disco. Only in Bermondsey would the night bus turn into a dance party.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy selling homemade kombucha from a bike at Hermannplatz, I knew Neukölln had a beat all its own.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find an open-air flea market where street food and vintage vinyl mix seamlessly, creating a unique Saturday vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they’ve plotted routes to avoid the BART delays that seem to happen every Friday like clockwork.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy arguing passionately with the bus driver about the route—his hand gestures were like an unscripted street performance. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best tapas are at the popular spots, but the hidden bars with no signs serve the real gems. It's all about the locals' secrets.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they stand in the middle of the promenade, staring at the architecture like it’s a museum.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the Tube instead of just knowing to follow the crowd during rush hour.
Last Saturday, a magician boarded the 322 and performed card tricks the whole trip. Everyone forgot we were stuck in traffic on Coldharbour Lane.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade on the corner while their dog lounged in the sun—it felt like the true heartbeat of Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a rooftop bar with a swimming pool overlooking a graffiti-covered East Side Gallery. Sunsets here feel like art.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You'll see true locals dodge the crack in the sidewalk near 24th and Mission like it’s a minefield; tourists just walk right over it, blissfully unaware.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling on the bus while a kid doodled on the window. Just another day in the TL, where every ride feels like a live performance.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always assume Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it’s the street art and quirky local bars that truly capture its spirit.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them carrying a map, squinting at every street sign, and ordering ‘tapas’ by the platter instead of by the piece.
